text: CRITICAL DISPATCH: Storm surge has breached Embarcadero seawall between Downtown and Fremont Pier. Roadway submerged under 75cm to 85cm of fast-moving saltwater. Light vehicles and standard ambulances stalled. Hydrodynamic pressure has eroded asphalt. Complete corridor impassable to all wheeled vehicles.
action_required: Enforce mandatory perimeter closure at N_DOWNTOWN. Reroute all downtown evacuation traffic west via Market Street or Geary Expressway.

text: STRUCTURAL ALERT: North Bay Span approach has suffered transverse beam cracking and shear slip at pier 4 following the magnitude 6.8 tremor. Concrete spalling with exposed rebar. Span is sagging 14cm under dead load. Catastrophic collapse risk under dynamic vehicular loads.
action_required: Immediate total closure of Bay Overlook Causeway. Prohibit all emergency crossings. Direct north-bound heavy convoys to inland detours.

text: FACILITY ADVISORY: Harbor Pavilion Clinic basement flooded. Substation drowned, emergency diesel generators contaminated by seawater. Operational capacity compromised to 4%; only 2 triage beds available. ICU ventilators running on transient battery UPS (<45 mins remaining). Non-viable for trauma intake.
action_required: Divert all trauma and critical patient ambulances exclusively to Metro General Hospital (N_HOSP_GEN) or St. Jude Emergency Hospital (N_HOSP_STJUDE).

text: HAZARD REPORT: Landslide on 16th Street slope between Potrero and Mission. Mud, concrete debris, and downed 12kV transmission lines blocking both eastbound and westbound lanes. Live electrical arcing reported near water pooling.
action_required: Isolate power grid section. Barricade 16th Cross Connector. Emergency access to Metro General must utilize Vermont Direct Gate via Potrero Hill or Potrero Avenue Spine.

text: TRAFFIC CAUTION: Central Channel Viaduct and 4th Street link experiencing moderate standing water (12cm) and abandoned commuter vehicles. Single lane passable with speed restricted to 20 km/h. High-clearance tactical vehicles and 4x4 ambulances cleared for controlled crossing.
action_required: Assign traffic marshals. Use as secondary contingency route only if primary inland expressway is jammed.

text: CLEAR ROUTE CLEARANCE: High-elevation inland corridor along Geary Expressway and Western Addition Medical Way confirmed 100% operational, zero structural cracks, dry pavement, and dedicated emergency lanes established. St. Jude Emergency Hospital has 38 available trauma beds, intact generator grid, and surgical teams standing by.
action_required: Designate Geary -> Western Addition as Priority Arterial Green Channel for Westbound evacuation and casualty transport.
